name: Kalirent
author: mundfdevelopment

sections.description:
Kalirent lets you manage rental items (roof tents, campers, trailers, bikes, tools), customers and bookings directly in the WordPress admin, whether you rent them out or run an equipment hire. It checks availability before a booking is saved and shows all bookings in a resource calendar.

It is built for the small operator who rents out a handful of things and currently keeps them in a spreadsheet: no external service, no account anywhere, no monthly fee. Everything lives in your own WordPress database.

Free features:

  • Rental items with categories, price per day and deposit
  • Customer management
  • Bookings with automatic booking numbers and status workflow
  • Availability check with same-day turnover
  • Calendar and dashboard
  • Four blocks for the public site: item grid, availability check, read-only calendar and an inquiry form
  • Booking inquiries from the website, with honeypot, time token and rate limit instead of a captcha
  • Automatic e-mails on inquiry, confirmation, cancellation, completion and the day before the rental starts, with editable templates

Availability, done properly

Rental periods are half-open: a booking from the 10th to the 12th blocks the 10th and the 11th, so the next customer can pick the item up on the 12th. That is how a rental business actually works, and it is why Kalirent does not lose a day of revenue on every turnover.

Privacy

Kalirent sends nothing anywhere. There are no external fonts, no CDN and no tracking in the admin or on the frontend, and customer data stays in your WordPress database. The inquiry form stores no IP addresses — the spam protection works on hashes and a hidden field.

Kalirent Pro

Handover and return protocols, photos, signatures, damage reports, PDF contracts and an audit log are part of Kalirent Pro, a separate commercial plugin available at mundf-development.de/kalirent.

Pro is a plugin of its own. None of its code ships inside this free plugin, and nothing here is locked, crippled or waiting for a key — Kalirent Free is the complete free product. See the “Kalirent Pro” section below.

Kalirent Pro

Kalirent Pro is a separate, commercial add-on plugin for operators who hand the item over in person and want that documented. It is sold at mundf-development.de/kalirent and installed as its own plugin — no Pro code is contained in this free plugin, and no feature here stops working without it.

Pro adds:

  • Handover and return protocols with checklists, run from a phone at the vehicle
  • Photos and customer signatures captured on the device
  • Damage reports with cost tracking
  • PDF contracts and protocols from editable templates
  • Private file storage outside the media library
  • An audit log of every booking change

Kalirent Free keeps working on its own, before and after Pro, and Pro can be deactivated at any time without losing data.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/kalirent, or install it through Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Open “Kalirent” in the admin menu.
  4. Under Kalirent > Settings, set your currency, default country and the e-mail sender address.
  5. Create your item categories, then your items.
  6. Optional: put the Kalirent blocks on a page — “Kalirent: Items”, “Kalirent: Availability”, “Kalirent: Calendar” and “Kalirent: Booking form” — so visitors can check availability and send an inquiry.

Requirements: WordPress 6.4 or newer and PHP 8.2 or newer. Kalirent creates its own database tables on activation; it does not store your rental data as posts or custom post types.
sections.faq:
Does uninstalling delete my data?

No. Data is only removed when “Delete data on uninstall” is enabled in Kalirent > Settings. Deactivating the plugin never deletes anything.

How does the availability check handle the return day?

Periods are half-open. A booking from the 10th to the 12th blocks the 10th and the 11th; another booking may start on the 12th. Inquiries do not block availability — only confirmed and running bookings do.

Can visitors book directly on my website?

They can send an inquiry with the booking form block. It arrives in Kalirent with the status “inquiry” and waits for you to confirm it. There is no online payment in the free version.

How is the inquiry form protected against spam?

With a hidden honeypot field, a signed time token (a form submitted in under three seconds is rejected) and a per-hour rate limit. Optionally the e-mail domain can be checked for a DNS record. No captcha, no third-party service, and no IP address is stored.

Which e-mails does Kalirent send, and can I change the wording?

Inquiry received (to the customer and to you), booking created, confirmed, cancelled, completed, and a reminder the day before the rental starts. Subject and body of every template are editable under Kalirent > Settings > E-mail, with placeholders such as {{customer_name}} and {{booking_number}}. Clearing a template resets it to the default.

Does Kalirent work with my theme?

The admin is a React application inside wp-admin and does not touch your theme. The four blocks render their own markup with rf- prefixed classes and load no external assets, so they inherit your theme’s typography and colours.

Is there a German version?

The interface is fully translatable through the text domain kalirent. Translations, including German, are provided through translate.wordpress.org.

Where do I report a bug?

On the support forum for this plugin, or at mundf-development.de/kalirent.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Translations are loaded by WordPress from translate.wordpress.org; the plugin no longer bundles its own.

1.0.2

  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.
  • Block render templates refuse direct access; code-quality fixes from the WordPress.org Plugin Check.

1.0.1

  • Inquiry form works behind page caches: the spam-protection token is loaded when the form starts instead of being stored in the page.
  • A customer created by a rejected inquiry is removed again; existing customers are no longer renamed from the public form.
  • The inquiry confirmation e-mail no longer repeats the visitor’s message.
  • Public inquiries reject past start dates and overly long periods.
  • Overlapping inquiries can be edited and cancelled again.
  • Public calendar and availability check match the booking rules exactly and no longer reveal inactive items.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Rental items with categories, price per day and deposit.
  • Customers, bookings with booking numbers and a status workflow.
  • Availability check with half-open periods and same-day turnover.
  • Resource calendar and dashboard.
  • Four blocks: items, availability, calendar and inquiry form.
  • Public inquiry API with honeypot, time token and rate limit.
  • Transactional e-mails with editable templates and a daily reminder cron.
